description: An older bearded man with grey hair, in a dark cloak, sits on a stone bench under a fig tree, gesturing with one hand and holding a flatbread. Four people listen nearby: a woman seated on the ground, a woman standing behind, and two men, one holding bread. Bowls of figs, olives and bread sit on the ground, with clay amphorae at the edges. Behind them is a ruined stone wall covered in ivy, with a low sun in the background. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no text or border.
